function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### Best Men’s Underwear Styles (2024) When it comes to men’s underwear, the “best” style depends on a mix of comfort, fit, fabric, and purpose. Below is a quick guide to the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for. | Style | Typical Use | Key Features | Pros | Cons | |-------|-------------|--------------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Everyday wear, sports, travel | • Long leg, snug fit
• Elastic waistband
• Often made from breathable cotton or moisture‑wicking blends | • Provides support and coverage
• Good for active use
• Versatile for all body types | • Can feel restrictive for some
• May show through tight clothing if not well‑cut | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Daily wear, formal occasions | • Short leg, snug fit
• High waistband
• Usually cotton or modal | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk under clothing | • Less coverage; can be uncomfortable for taller men
• Not ideal for high‑impact activities | | **Boxers** | Casual, lounging, sleep | • Loose fit, short or long leg
• Soft cotton or bamboo | • Breathable, airy feel
• Great for relaxed settings | • Lack support; can bunch up
• Not suitable for active wear | | **Trunks** | Trendy everyday wear, gym | • Short leg, snug fit
• Similar to boxer briefs but shorter | • Modern look
• Good support with less bulk | • May feel too tight for some
• Limited coverage | | **Compression Briefs** | Athletic performance, recovery | • Tight, elasticized fabric
• Often made from spandex blends | • Supports muscles, reduces vibration
• Ideal for running, cycling | • Can feel restrictive if too tight
• Requires careful sizing | | **Hipsters** | Fashion-forward, casual | • Low-rise, mid‑thigh coverage
• Elastic waistband | • Comfortable for those who dislike high waist
• Good for skinny jeans | • May not provide enough support for active use | | **Boys’ Style (Boyshorts)** | Comfort, maternity, plus‑size | • Full coverage, elastic waistband
• Often made from soft fabrics | • Great for larger hips
• Comfortable for all-day wear | • Not as trendy for younger men
• Can be bulky under tight pants | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Sports, travel, high‑tech fabrics | • Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry | • Keeps you dry and odor‑free
• Ideal for long trips or workouts | • Usually pricier
• May lack the classic look | --- #### How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Active**: Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. - **Sedentary**: Boxers or briefs for breathability. - **Travel**: Quick‑dry, anti‑odor briefs or boxer briefs. 2. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the natural waist without digging. - **Leg Length**: Boxers and trunks vary; choose based on your leg length and preference for coverage. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, but may absorb sweat. - **Modal / Bamboo**: Soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Polyester / Spandex Blends**: Stretchy, durable, good for performance. - **Merino Wool**: Excellent for temperature regulation and odor control. 4. **Special Features** - **Seamless or Flat‑lock stitching**: Reduces irritation. - **Anti‑odor treatment**: Useful for long trips or hot climates. - **Eco‑friendly materials**: Bamboo, recycled polyester, or organic cotton. 5. **Try Them On** - If possible, test a few styles in-store or order from retailers with generous return policies. Comfort is subjective—what feels great for one person may not for another. --- #### Top Picks (2024) | Brand | Style | Why It’s Great | |-------|-------|----------------| | **Uniqlo** | Ultra Stretch Briefs | Affordable, breathable, excellent fit. | | **Calvin Klein** | Modern Trunks | Classic design, high-quality fabric. | | **Under Armour** | Tech Performance Boxer Briefs | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, great for athletes. | | **Lululemon** | Align Boxer Briefs | Ultra‑soft, seamless, perfect for everyday wear. | | **Hanes** | ComfortSoft Boxers | Budget-friendly, soft cotton, great for lounging. | | **Patagonia** | Breathe™ Performance Briefs | Eco‑friendly, quick‑dry, anti‑odor. | | **Tommy John** | Second Skin Briefs | Seamless, no‑pocket design, premium feel. | --- #### Quick FAQ - **Do I need a different style for each season?** *Not necessarily.* Moisture‑wicking fabrics work year‑round, but you might prefer cotton in summer and wool or thermal blends in winter. - **Can I wear the same underwear for work and gym?** *Yes, if you choose a performance boxer brief or compression brief that offers support and moisture control.* - **What’s the best way to care for performance underwear?** *Wash in cold water, avoid fabric softener, and tumble dry on low heat to preserve elasticity.* --- **Bottom line:** The best men’s underwear style is the one that balances support, comfort, and fabric performance for your daily activities. Experiment with a few options, pay attention to fit and material, and you’ll find the perfect pair that feels like a second skin. Happy shopping!
